explanation: It is 0 everywhere except at GO when the agent chooses a2 and the trial just before was rewarded right after one or more unrewarded trials: then it is about 10, or only about 2-3 if that was a single loss inside a long run of rewards. On the next rewarded a2 GO steps it drops to about 2, then 1, then 0; it is always 0 when the agent chooses a1, at every D1 and D2, and right after an unrewarded trial.
